posts.author: JohnFP
posts.content_md:
> yes thats the problem we all go thru, in the beginning the only ones you can give away are the best ones , and that leaves you with the memory of how good a hologram it was ......and the leftover pile of scrap!

Oh, how true. I wish I had my first hologram. It was a model car with a little model man setting on the hood and the car was on a black optics book lying down with the word "Optics" visible on the edge of the book. I loved that hologram but gave it to a college buddy that I have not seen or heard from in years. It was made in my basement with the sandbox holography kit, a Metrologic HeNe that came as a kit and had to be built and my first box of Agfa 4x5 plates.

I may have to reproduce that hologram for memory sake. I think I still have the book.
